Lyle Industries, an ISO 9001:2015 certified automotive textile carpet manufacturer founded in 1981 and headquartered in Dalton, Georgia. Founded by Lamar and Loutrelle Lyle, the company operates three manufacturing plants and produces up to 34.5 million square yards of tufted carpet per year for OEM, Aftermarket, and Accessory vehicle markets across North America.
Lyle Company produces these for both OEM fitment and aftermarket replacement kits.

Lyle Company produces OEM-specification floor mats shipped direct to vehicle assembly plants and aftermarket replacement mats distributed through automotive parts channels. Material options include nylon-face cut-pile and polypropylene loop constructions.

These capabilities collectively position Lyle Industries as a qualified supplier for programs at major North American assembly facilities operated by Ford Motor Company, General Motors, Stellantis, Toyota Motor Corporation, and their respective Tier 1 interior trim suppliers.

Lyle Industries operates out of Dalton, Georgia, a city recognized nationally as the center of U.S. carpet and rug production. The company runs three manufacturing plants in the Dalton area. Dalton's position at the I-75 corridor provides direct freight access to major North American vehicle assembly plants in Tennessee, Alabama, Michigan, and Ontario.
